source: aion2hub.com item database, Decor category (Global + Korea/Taiwan data, read 2026-10-16); colossus grants cross-checked with aion.xtopolis.com and aion2.tools/guides/pantheon
note: Pantheon decorations: one Colossus (centre), four Statues (inner ring) and twelve Artworks (outer ring) are placed at a time; a decoration fits only its own slot type and only placed decorations count. Each point of a deity stat adds 0.1% to its two effects. 'global' false marks items only in the Korea/Taiwan client data so far. Items without stats have no effect block in the source data and are listed for completeness only. Ownership is not in any supported source: the board recommends by modeled damage value and tells you where each piece comes from.
